method: Local Win32_Process provider-side exact owned-nonce filters; unrelated CommandLine fields never selected or returned
owned_query: SELECT ProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='node.exe' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%3dbf83cfbcbc4692b3c05f28fd60c25c%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%66a72810dd084216b06579edb2e968bd%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%b1ad5f2c1a90494bb867b01c5e16e138%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%c9d241fb55b34b31a38dfd2c82d02d9c%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%d2e5ef2496314d76b04d75dc31ca6f19%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fc2d957c7f70402bb0d88ab2337a1ae0%')
historical_note: c9d failed control has no recorded PID/exit; those facts stay unknown. This query only checks current owned-nonce command lines, after proving no Node command lines are null.
